body.title: Rewrite the #prerequisites section (Node + Ollama split + model lists)
body.summary: In site/getting-started.html, restructure #prerequisites around Node + Ollama: Ollama REQUIRED for embeddings (Ollama qwen3-embedding:0.6b default + the no-Ollama ONNX nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5) and OPTIONAL for the core model (qwen3.6:27b default / qwen3.6:35b-a3b larger / cloud via claude|codex CLI, models.tiers.core.runner). Reuse the existing table/.tip/.code idioms; keep the #prerequisites anchor; keep qwen3.6:27b as the default (do NOT switch to 35b-a3b).
acceptanceChecks: #prerequisites frames Ollama as REQUIRED for embeddings and OPTIONAL for the core model.
Embedding models listed: qwen3-embedding:0.6b (Ollama) + nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5 (ONNX, no Ollama).
Core models listed: qwen3.6:27b (default) + qwen3.6:35b-a3b (larger) + cloud via claude/codex CLI; 27b stays the default.
The #prerequisites anchor + Node.js 20+/claude+codex/git rows are preserved; existing idioms reused.

tests.name: #prerequisites shows Node + Ollama; Ollama REQUIRED for embeddings, OPTIONAL for core
embedding + core model lists render (qwen3-embedding:0.6b / nomic-embed-text-v1.5 / qwen3.6:27b default / 35b-a3b larger / cloud)
grep getting-started.html confirms exact model ids + no 35b-a3b default substitution
